choices.reason: No candidate is explicitly named primary; the introduction's findings summary highlights the unadjusted idea-quantity contrast reported in Section 4.1, while omitting the within-person diversity result. The SEM candidate is the separate RQ3 direct timing path adjusted for autonomy, ownership, and creative self-efficacy, so rule 2 favors the main quantity comparison.
